dataNotes: Run timing: this cycle ran the morning of Friday 6 November 2026 after the GitHub Actions fetch job drafted contracts/*.2026-11-05.json from Thursday 5 November's close. Every figure used is dated at or before 2026-11-05; the 6 November news-log entries (October payrolls, Asia rout, premarket chip rebound) were NOT used.

Bonds, dollar and IWM sigma are not auto-fetched; the last obtainable implied-volatility values (TLT 30-day IV, EUR/USD 1-month ATM IV, RVX) were carried forward again with stale-source notes. The RVX carry (19.97) likely understates current small-cap vol after VIX jumped to 28.18.
News-log entries for 2026-11-05 (six, matching the Artifact database exactly; no hand-entered entries) were read. No separate web search was run, to keep the blindness rule clean.

Category 1-12 votes are neutral unless a dated source in the news log gives a clear read (Rates, Earnings, Macro calendar and Cross-asset are 1D-only; Fed path is horizon-wide; Positioning uses the Vanda retail-flow figure for equities/Nasdaq/Russell at 5D only); Trend structure follows the computed structure reads; Market structure carries its own mechanical direction.
